title: Installing an Antique Gas-Light Fixture: Wiring, Box Mount, and LED Retrofit
summary: This Old House demonstrates installing an antique Victorian gas-light fixture converted to electric, focusing on safe wiring and ceiling-mount considerations in a setting with exposed components and limited attic access. The hosts identify hazards in the existing setup (three-conductor BX cable, no dedicated ground, exposed splices) and outline a plan to mount a metal junction box using a mounting bar, re-route wiring through a new ceiling opening, and splice the fixture to the circuit. The process includes removing an obstructing gas pipe, using anti-short bushings and grounding clamps, and completing the installation with an antique-style push-button switch that incorporates a dimmer and LED bulbs designed to mimic an original glow. The overall emphasis is on safely integrating old and new elements while preserving the fixture’s historic appearance.
topics: antique gas-light fixture converted to electric
ceiling box mounting without attic access
preserving historic aesthetic in modern wiring

sections.title: Hazards and fixture background
concepts: antique Victorian gas-light fixture converted to electric
sections.description: Introduction to the safety concerns of the existing setup: a bare light bulb with exposed wiring and an antique gas-light fixture converted to electric that needs proper wiring and mounting.

sections.title: Wiring configuration and box considerations
sections.description: Explanation of the three-wire feed (power, feed to next room, feed to switch) and the absence of a dedicated ground, with emphasis on BX cable and the need for a metal junction box.

sections.title: Mounting strategy using expansion bar
sections.description: Introduction of an expansion-bar hanger that anchors into wood joists to securely mount the electrical box when attic access is limited.

sections.title: Hole planning and gas pipe obstacle
sections.description: Procedure for outlining and cutting the ceiling hole, including the discovery and clearance of an old gas pipe in the installation path.

sections.title: Wiring protection and grounding hardware
sections.description: Use of anti-short bushings to protect conductors and grounding clamps to connect wires to the electrical blocks.

sections.title: Splicing and fixture connection
sections.description: Splicing conductors to each other and to the new light fixture as part of completing the electrical connection.

sections.title: Switch and LED aesthetic
sections.description: Testing the switch and final lighting with LED bulbs designed to emit an antique glow, preserving the period look while using modern components.
